ledger.claim: This trip's own GPS trace establishes the deviation, and by a wide margin. gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-00507 is 11.36 km against a booked optimal of 3.6 km carried on EV-TRIP-00507, an excess of 7.76 km — 215.6% of the optimal route (derived.deviation.excess_km and derived.deviation.excess_pct on EV-GPS-00507). Both POL-RD-01 establishment gates are cleared: the excess is far greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km and far greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. Because the excess also exceeds 50% of the optimal distance, this is additionally a MATERIAL deviation. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing measurement and expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km, a rounded convenience copy, from the threshold test — so the finding is safe on the trace figure, and would be safe on the rounded figure too.

The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so the deviation can stand on it alone. EV-GPS-00507 is admissibility-COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, carries 127 fixes at a 10 second cadence with 100% coverage, reports no gaps at all and a max_gap_sec of 0.0. None of POL-RD-07's impairment limbs (a) to (c) fires. The independent-corroboration requirement in POL-RD-07(ii), and the escalation that would follow from it under POL-RD-10(3), are therefore not engaged, and no discount attaches to the trace.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged on the face of the bundle. The trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry the same trip identifier TRP-00507 and describe the same pickup event, and the excess is measured from a trace that is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c). The additional-corroboration proviso in POL-RD-08 does not bite either: EV-RPROF-00507 shows rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d of 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 0, far below the 4-and-1 threshold. No profile field beyond those the clause names is relied on; under POL-GEN-01 the profiles go only to how closely assertions are scrutinised, never to a fact about this trip.

No traffic-advisory exoneration is available, and the absence is itself the evidence. EV-ADVIS-00507-01 is MISSING: its payload is null, its weight_multiplier is 0.0, and the pre-pass records a blocking MISSING_ARTIFACT issue — 'No advisory covers Airport Boulevard or Changi Coast Rd in this window.' A missing artifact can carry no fact, but under POL-GEN-02(3) its absence is citable, and the driver's side points to no advisory ID at all. POL-RD-03 exonerates only where an advisory names a road the optimal route traverses within a validity window, and there is no advisory to run that test on. Nothing about this detour is exonerated.

No rider-requested-detour exoneration is available. The chat log for this trip, EV-CHAT-00507, is admissibility-COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and contains zero messages — message_count 0 with an empty messages array. POL-RD-04 requires an instruction from the rider recorded in the chat_log, timestamped before the vehicle leaves the optimal corridor or at most three minutes after, identifying a place or road specifically enough to act on. No such message exists, and because there is no chat message there is no chat_message.waypoint_hint against which the 200 m corroboration test could be run, so that test is undecidable and the clause is unavailable on this record.

No relocation exoneration is available either. EV-TRIP-00507 shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null, so the POL-RD-05 re-quote does not exist and the clause cannot be run on this record. Nor is this a pooled trip: vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline has no application and the booked optimal of 3.6 km is the correct baseline for the threshold test.

The driver's explanation names no artifact and carries no weight. His account that Changi Beach is very long, that the rider could not say which car park, and that he 'chose a quiet spot', is an assertion that identifies no evidence ID on either the route or the destination. POL-RD-08 is explicit that assertions from either side which cite no evidence ID are discarded; the empty chat log at EV-CHAT-00507 confirms no rider instruction exists to support it, and 'the meter is the meter' is not a defence, because POL-RD-02 fixes the refund arithmetically against the optimal route rather than against what was metered.

The refund is arithmetic and the figures are these, stated on separate lines as POL-RD-02 requires. charged_total is 25.03 (EV-FARE-00507; payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 3.6 optimal km + 0.28 x 7.0 optimal min) x the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier = (3.80 + 2.70 + 1.96) = 8.46, plus 0.80 platform fee = 9.26, plus the fixed Changi Airport surcharge of 6.00 already itemised and properly chargeable on a trip originating at the airport = 15.26; no ERP or toll charge arises, waiting_time_fee is 0.00 and promo_discount is 0.00. The refund is 25.03 − 15.26 = 9.77, rounded UP to SGD 9.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 39.0% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.80.

No separate pass-through correction arises, and the rider claims none on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The 6.00 airport surcharge is properly chargeable because this trip ORIGINATES at Changi Airport Terminal 3, so POL-RD-09(4)'s billing-integrity correction does not bite on that line. Every ERP total on the fare_breakdown is 0.00 and the erp_gantries list is empty, so there is nothing for POL-RD-09 to add. POL-RD-09(1) forbids stacking off-route ERP on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, and the rider does not ask for it: the single refund of SGD 9.80 is the whole of the money sought.

Because the deviation is MATERIAL, POL-RD-06 requires the driver_profile check, and it must be run on the field the clause names. The trip's chat log is complete and empty: message_count 0, messages [], first_message_at and last_message_at null, truncated false. There is no recorded rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and no admission anywhere in the bundle, and under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight. That narrative cannot enlarge a remedy which the measured distance already fixes.

The further complaint that the dropoff was the wrong spot is not a distance question and has no evidentiary anchor. POL-RD-01 measures deviation by distance between the recorded pickup and dropoff events, and the recorded dropoff is 'Nicoll Drive, Changi'; both recorded endpoints carry venue_id null and neither carries an amendment timestamp, so no artifact in this bundle identifies any specific point the rider asked for and did not get. A finding that this stretch of Nicoll Drive is or is not 'Changi Beach' would have to rest on general geography, which is not evidence and cannot ground a remedy beyond the distance arithmetic.

Nothing on this record needs a human. The same trip identifier TRP-00507 is carried by the trip record, the trace and the fare ledger; the trace runs 127 fixes at a 10 second cadence with gaps [] and max_gap_sec 0.0 from 12:21:40 to 12:42:40, matching the trip record's started_at and ended_at, so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c); the computed refund of 9.77 is far below the 150.00 ceiling and below charged_total; and every charge line has a counterpart on the trip. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires, and the case should be decided on the POL-RD-02 figure of 9.80.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides' claims were tested against the record, and they converge on the same arithmetic. Here is the decision.

DEVIATION — ESTABLISHED AND MATERIAL. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00507 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) records 11.36 km driven against the booked optimal of 3.6 km on EV-TRIP-00507 — an excess of 7.76 km, or 215.6% of optimal. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs (trip_record.actual_distance_km, 11.4, is a rounded convenience copy and was not used for the threshold test). Both establishment gates are cleared by a wide margin, and because the excess also exceeds 50% of optimal it is additionally a MATERIAL deviation. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a)–(c): 127 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, gaps [], max_gap_sec 0.0. No independent corroboration is therefore required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. (POL-GEN-02 draws a sharp line between schema impairment and policy impairment; on this bundle no artifact is impaired at either level except the advisory discussed below.)

NO EXONERATION. POL-RD-03: traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00507-01 is MISSING — payload null, weight_multiplier 0.0, blocking MISSING_ARTIFACT issue ('No advisory covers Airport Boulevard or Changi Coast Rd in this window'). Under POL-GEN-02(3) a missing artifact carries no fact; I rely only on its absence, and no closure exoneration is available. POL-RD-04: chat log EV-CHAT-00507 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and empty (message_count 0, messages [], no waypoint_hint), so the rider-instruction test has no input and the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run; the clause is unavailable on this record. POL-RD-05: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km / amended_optimal_duration_min are both null, so no re-quote exists and the clause cannot be run. POL-RD-12: vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, so the solo-rider optimal of 3.6 km is the correct baseline. No driver compensation arises under POL-RD-04's second limb either: the billed distance (11.4 km) is not less than the trace distance (11.36 km), so there is no unbilled shortfall.

REFUND ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02), stated on separate lines as the clause requires:
  • charged_total = SGD 25.03 (EV-FARE-00507; payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00)
  • recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 3.6 optimal km + 0.28 × 7.0 optimal min) × surge_multiplier 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier = 8.46, + 0.80 platform fee = 9.26, + 6.00 fixed Changi Airport surcharge = SGD 15.26 (no ERP, waiting_time_fee 0.00, promo_discount 0.00)
  • refund = 25.03 − 15.26 = SGD 9.77, rounded UP to SGD 9.80
The airport surcharge is properly chargeable and not a billing defect, because the trip ORIGINATES at Changi Airport Terminal 3 Door 5; the SGD 6.00 line is the off-peak rate and the trip ran on a Wednesday at 12:15, so POL-RD-09(4) does not bite. All ERP totals are 0.00 with an empty gantry list, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing, and POL-RD-09(1) forbids bolting a pass-through line onto the POL-RD-02 figure. The refund is 39.0% of charged_total — below the 90% share that would convert this to FULL_REFUND — and above the SGD 0.50 de minimis. The outcome is therefore PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.80; the rider's contested SGD 25.03 is not returned in full and the driver is not further charged.

DRIVER PROFILE. POL-RD-06 is compulsory on a material deviation and it comes back clean on the two fields the clause names: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d = 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d = 250, so neither the 3-flag gate nor the 0.05 ratio gate is met. No repeat pattern is established, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01, and both advocates correctly said so rather than using it.

THE PARTIES' ACCOUNTS OF THE CONVERSATION AND THE DROPOFF. The rider's account — that she clearly asked for Changi Beach and was left on an empty road — and the driver's answer — that the beach is long, she could not name a car park, he 'chose a quiet spot' and 'the meter is the meter' — are both uncorroborated: the chat log is empty, neither recorded endpoint carries a venue_id or an amendment timestamp, and no artifact identifies a specific point the rider asked for and did not get. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion citing no evidence ID carries no weight, so neither narrative is a ground of decision; whether any particular stretch of Nicoll Drive is 'Changi Beach' is a question of general geography, which is not evidence. The driver's counterparty statement is admitted as evidence, but it does not carry any fact that decides this case — it concedes no route fault — and it enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the confidence cap.

ESCALATION. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-00507); the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c); the trip-record and trace timestamps agree to the second and nothing runs backwards; no exculpatory clause was invoked against a missing artifact (the advisory's absence is cited only as the absence of exoneration, not to found one); the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling and below charged_total; there is no mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength; and every charge line on the ledger has a counterpart — distance and time against the trace, the airport surcharge against the airport origin. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. No referral is produced by any clause: POL-RD-06(c) does not fire because no pattern is established, and POL-RD-09(4) does not fire because no gantry or surcharge line is phantom. This is a monetary ruling, not an escalation.

For transparency: the disputed amount moves SGD 9.80 back to the rider under POL-RD-02, and no platform-funded payment is made to the driver.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
